name: MonarchSchemaDrivenForm
title: SchemaDrivenForm
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchFieldRenderer, with MonarchButton, MonarchBanner, MonarchFormActionsBar and MonarchDescriptionList
summary: A form generated from a list of question definitions: the right input for each question, sections and conditional questions, validation, and a submit button that shows progress and errors.
whenToUse: For forms whose questions are data: admin-authored intake forms, settings defined on the server, surveys and applications. The same definitions drive MonarchFieldRenderer and a form builder's preview.
whenNotToUse: For a fixed form known at build time, compose MonarchTextField, MonarchSelect and the other inputs directly, which allows custom layout. For a single question, use MonarchFieldRenderer.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSchemaDrivenForm(fields: List<MonarchFormFieldDefinition>, values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>, onValuesChange: (values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>, fieldId: String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onSubmit: (suspend (values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>) -> Unit)? = null, validateOn: MonarchSchemaDrivenFormValidateOn = MonarchSchemaDrivenFormValidateOn.Blur, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, dirty: Boolean? = null, errors: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(), locale: Locale? = null, labels: MonarchSchemaDrivenFormLabels = MonarchSchemaDrivenFormLabels(), onDiscard: (() -> Unit)? = null, secondaryActions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchSchemaDrivenFormLabels(submit: String? = null, submitFailed: String? = null, empty: String? = null, fields: MonarchFieldRendererLabels = MonarchFieldRendererLabels(), actionsBar: MonarchFormActionsBarLabels = MonarchFormActionsBarLabels())

object MonarchSchemaDrivenFormDefaults { fun visibleFields(fields: List<MonarchFormFieldDefinition>, values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>): List<MonarchFormFieldDefinition>; fun problems(fields: List<MonarchFormFieldDefinition>, values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>): Map<String, MonarchFormFieldProblem>; fun submittedValues(fields: List<MonarchFormFieldDefinition>, values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>): Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?> }

options.name: fields
options.description: The questions and section headings, in order. A Section question starts a section that lasts until the next one.

options.name: values
options.description: The answers keyed by question id; a missing key is no answer.

options.name: onValuesChange
options.description: Called with all answers and the id of the question that changed.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the form. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: onSubmit
options.description: Receives the shown answers once valid; shows the submit button. Throw to show the error's message in a danger banner. Without it there is no submit button.

options.name: validateOn
options.description: Blur shows a typed question's error when focus leaves it and a choice's when it is answered; Submit waits for a submit attempt.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the answers can be changed and the form submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the shown answers as a MonarchDescriptionList instead of inputs.

options.name: dirty
options.description: null puts the submit button after the questions; a value pins a MonarchFormActionsBar under them that offers Save while true.

options.name: errors
options.description: Messages from the app, such as the server's, keyed by question id; shown at once, in place of the question's own error.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the questions.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of numbers and dates in the read-only view; null uses the configuration's first locale.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Save, the failure message and what TalkBack reads for an unanswered question in the read-only view, and the questions' and actions bar's strings.

options.name: onDiscard
options.description: With dirty, offers Discard in the actions bar, confirmed first.

options.name: secondaryActions
options.description: Further buttons after the submit button, such as Cancel.

states.name: editing
states.description: Each shown question with its input, label, help and required mark; no errors until validateOn says.

states.name: invalid
states.description: After a submit attempt, every invalid question shows its message; the form scrolls to the first one and moves focus into it.

states.name: submitting
states.description: The submit button shows progress and the inputs are disabled until onSubmit returns.

states.name: failed
states.description: onSubmit threw: its message, or The form could not be saved. Try again., in an assertive danger MonarchBanner, or in the actions bar with dirty.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled = false: inputs and the submit button are disabled.

states.name: read only
states.description: The shown answers as terms and values: option labels, Yes or No, a medium date, a locale number and file names; an unanswered question shows a dash, read as Not set.

appearance: The questions take the roles of the Monarch inputs MonarchFieldRenderer chooses; section headings use the subheading text role. Save is a primary MonarchButton, a failure a danger MonarchBanner, and the read-only view a MonarchDescriptionList. No fill of its own. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's SchemaDrivenForm has its own field schema (text, textarea, number, select, checkbox, switch, date) with regular-expression patterns, custom validate functions and controlled or uncontrolled values. On Android it renders the MonarchFormFieldDefinition schema that MonarchFieldRenderer and the form builder already use, so it covers more types (email, phone, web address, time, radio, checkboxes, multi-select, yes or no, consent, rating, file) and its rules (required, lengths, ranges, selections, formats); there is no pattern or validate function: the app adds its own checks through errors. Sections are Section questions in the flat list rather than nested groups, and conditions are MonarchConditions. Values are always hoisted. The web's submitLabel = null and form attribute become onSubmit = null, with MonarchSchemaDrivenFormDefaults for apps that submit from elsewhere. The web's blur maps to focus leaving a typed question; choices count as visited when answered, because touch has no blur. The dirty actions bar is Android-only, for edit forms. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: Each question keeps the semantics of its Monarch input: the label names the input, the required mark and help are read with it, and a new error is announced by MonarchFormField.
An invalid submit moves focus into the first invalid question after scrolling to it.
A failed submit is an assertive MonarchBanner, so it is announced at once.
Save shows a busy state while submitting and the inputs are disabled.
Save and the secondary actions have 48dp touch targets and wrap at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: Hidden questions, and every question of a hidden section, are neither validated nor submitted; their answers stay in values.
errors win over the question's own message and show before any submit attempt.
A question with readOnly keeps a readable text field; other read-only questions are disabled, as in MonarchFieldRenderer.
onSubmit = null shows no submit button; MonarchSchemaDrivenFormDefaults.problems and submittedValues let the app submit from a top app bar.
The questions are a LazyColumn: give the form a bounded height and do not put it in a vertically scrolling parent.

examples.title: Booking form with sections and a conditional field
examples.webExample: Booking form with sections and a conditional field
examples.template:
MonarchSchemaDrivenForm(
    fields = fields,
    values = answers,
    onValuesChange = { all, _ ->
        answers.clear()
        answers.putAll(all)
    },
    modifier = Modifier.height(1100.dp),
    yesNoAsSwitch = true,
    onSubmit = { values -> /* Send the answers; throw to show an error. */ },
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    labels = MonarchSchemaDrivenFormLabels(submit = {{submitLabel}}),
)
examples.setupTemplate:
val fields = listOf(
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("you", MonarchFormFieldType.Section, {{you.title}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("name", MonarchFormFieldType.ShortText, {{name.label}}, required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("email", MonarchFormFieldType.Email, {{email.label}}, required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("visit", MonarchFormFieldType.Section, {{visit.title}}, description = {{visit.description}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition(
        "topic",
        MonarchFormFieldType.Select,
        {{topic.label}},
        placeholder = {{topic.placeholder}},
        required = true,
        options = listOf(
            MonarchFormFieldOption({{topic.options.0.value}}, {{topic.options.0.label}}),
            MonarchFormFieldOption({{topic.options.1.value}}, {{topic.options.1.label}}),
            MonarchFormFieldOption({{topic.options.2.value}}, {{topic.options.2.label}}),
        ),
    ),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("guests", MonarchFormFieldType.Number, {{guests.label}}, min = {{guests.min|double}}, max = {{guests.max|double}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("date", MonarchFormFieldType.Date, {{date.label}}, minDate = {{date.min|millis}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("reminder", MonarchFormFieldType.YesNo, {{reminder.label}}, description = {{reminder.description}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("consent", MonarchFormFieldType.Consent, {{consent.label}}, required = true),
)
val answers = remember {
    mutableStateMapOf<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>("reminder" to MonarchFormFieldValue.Flag({{reminder.value}}))
}
examples.setup:
val fields = listOf(
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("you", MonarchFormFieldType.Section, "Your details"),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("name", MonarchFormFieldType.ShortText, "Full name", required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("email", MonarchFormFieldType.Email, "Email", required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("visit", MonarchFormFieldType.Section, "Your visit", description = "Tell us what to prepare."),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition(
        "topic",
        MonarchFormFieldType.Select,
        "Topic",
        placeholder = "Choose…",
        required = true,
        options = listOf(
            MonarchFormFieldOption("demo", "Product demo"),
            MonarchFormFieldOption("support", "Support question"),
            MonarchFormFieldOption("other", "Something else"),
        ),
    ),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("guests", MonarchFormFieldType.Number, "Guests", min = 1.0, max = 10.0),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("date", MonarchFormFieldType.Date, "Preferred date", minDate = 1_767_225_600_000L),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("reminder", MonarchFormFieldType.YesNo, "Email reminder", description = "One day before."),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("consent", MonarchFormFieldType.Consent, "I agree to be contacted about this booking", required = true),
)
val answers = remember {
    mutableStateMapOf<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>("reminder" to MonarchFormFieldValue.Flag(true))
}
examples.code:
MonarchSchemaDrivenForm(
    fields = fields,
    values = answers,
    onValuesChange = { all, _ ->
        answers.clear()
        answers.putAll(all)
    },
    modifier = Modifier.height(1100.dp),
    yesNoAsSwitch = true,
    onSubmit = { values -> /* Send the answers; throw to show an error. */ },
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-GB"),
    labels = MonarchSchemaDrivenFormLabels(submit = "Book"),
)

examples.title: An edit form that saves from the actions bar
examples.code:
MonarchSchemaDrivenForm(
    fields = fields,
    values = answers,
    onValuesChange = { all, _ -> answers = all },
    modifier = Modifier.height(240.dp),
    onSubmit = { values -> saved = values },
    dirty = answers != saved,
    onDiscard = { answers = saved },
)
